#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-resident-full100
export PLOW_HSACO_LOWRUNG=""
export PLOW_DSTEP_LOG=0
if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then set -- on; fi
for arm in "$@"; do
    export PLOW_HSACO="$root/overlay"
    "$root/plowrt" serve --assets "$root/assets-$arm" --port 18999 > "$root/server-$arm.log" 2>&1 &
    server=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    ready=0
    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
        if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18999/v1/models > "$root/models-$arm.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
        kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
        sleep 1
    done
    [ "$ready" = 1 ]
    python3 runtime/bench/amd/mla_sparse_aiter/quality.py http://127.0.0.1:18999 "resident-$arm" "$root/quality-$arm.json" --concurrency 20 > "$root/quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18999 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 100 --random-input-len 70000 --random-output-len 700 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$root" --result-filename "serve-$arm.json" > "$root/bench-$arm.log" 2>&1
    kill -TERM "$server"
    wait "$server" || [ "$?" = 143 ]
    trap - EXIT
done

import collections
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

root = Path(__file__).parent / 'cold'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
arms = {}
for arm in ('control', 'segments'):
    path = root / arm / 'run.log'
    log = path.read_text()
    results = []
    for match in re.finditer(r'^\{', log, re.M):
        try:
            value, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(log[match.start():])
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            results.append(value)
    assert len(results) == 1, len(results)
    benchmark = results[0]
    assert benchmark['num_gpus'] == 8
    assert len(benchmark['rows']) == 1
    measured = benchmark['rows'][0]
    assert (measured['completed'], measured['failed'], measured['prompt_tokens']) == (1, 0, 70000)
    assert (measured['warmup_requests'], measured['repetitions'], measured['input']['seed']) == (0, 1, 0)
    rows = []
    pattern = r'^PLOW_PREFILL_SEG_TIMING program=(\d+) bucket=(\d+) c0=(\d+) clen=(\d+) segment=(\d+) family=(\S+) enqueue_us=([0-9.]+) critical_us=([0-9.]+)$'
    for values in re.findall(pattern, log, re.M):
        rows.append(dict(zip(('program', 'bucket', 'c0', 'clen', 'segment', 'family', 'enqueue_us', 'critical_us'),
                             [int(v) for v in values[:5]] + [values[5]] + [float(v) for v in values[6:]])))
    grouped = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        grouped[row['c0']].append(row)
    if arm == 'segments':
        assert sorted(grouped) == list(range(0, 70000, 8192))
        for c0, chunk in grouped.items():
            assert [r['segment'] for r in chunk] == list(range(781))
            assert {r['clen'] for r in chunk} == {min(8192, 70000 - c0)}
            assert {r['bucket'] for r in chunk} == {8192}
    else:
        assert rows == []
    families = collections.defaultdict(lambda: dict(segments=0, enqueue_us=0, critical_us=0))
    for row in rows:
        group = families[row['family']]
        group['segments'] += 1
        group['enqueue_us'] += row['enqueue_us']
        group['critical_us'] += row['critical_us']
    arms[arm] = dict(benchmark=benchmark, families=families, rows=rows,
                     source=json.loads((root / arm / 'source.json').read_text()), run_log_sha256=sha(path))
record = dict(schema='plow.glm.resident-prefill-segments.v1', date='2026-09-10', artifact_root=str(root), arms=arms,
              parser_source=Path(__file__).read_text(), parser_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),
              limitations=[
                  'One cold 70k-token request per fresh process, deterministic benchmark token IDs; not the vLLM random serving workload.',
                  'Prefix caching disabled in both diagnostic processes; serving defaults are unchanged.',
                  'Segment instrumentation adds all-rank drains. Family sums include host submission and synchronization, not isolated GPU kernel duration.',
                  'A prior attempt stopped before prefill because the benchmark rejected prefix caching; preserved separately in the parent directory.',
              ])
(root / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({arm: dict(benchmark_keys=list(r['benchmark']), families=r['families']) for arm, r in arms.items()}, indent=2))
limitations: One cold 70k-token request per fresh process, deterministic benchmark token IDs; not the vLLM random serving workload.
Prefix caching disabled in both diagnostic processes; serving defaults are unchanged.
Segment instrumentation adds all-rank drains. Family sums include host submission and synchronization, not isolated GPU kernel duration.
A prior attempt stopped before prefill because the benchmark rejected prefix caching; preserved separately in the parent directory.
